block.create_dragons_plus.fluid_hatch.to: _Deposits_ _contained fluid_ from your _held item_ into the _tank_ it is placed on. If the held item cannot be emptied, it _fills_ the item from the _tank_ instead.
_Fills_ your _held fluid container_ from the _tank_ first. If it cannot be filled, contained fluid is _deposited_ into the _tank_ instead.
